name: Piteälven-Gásakláhko

difficulty.summary: No official difficulty grade found. Treat as remote mountain stage: wet low forest/lake-shore start, climb to exposed fell, poor visibility risk, sparse facilities and no direct road access.

routeType: mainline hiking stage; roadless wilderness section; camping-only official accommodation

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route page
officialSources.evidence: Lists stage 3 / etapp 3 as Piteälven-Gásakláhko, 19 km, 7-9 hours, accommodation Camping; stage 4 as Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken, 13 km, 4-6 hours. Describes Gásakláhko as high-elevation camping terrain, not a hut or coordinate POI.
officialSources.caveat: No official endpoint coordinate or campsite POI is published for Gásakláhko.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan / Länsstyrelsen BD78 Piteälven-Jäckvik route
officialSources.evidence: Official broader route page for Vandringsled BD78 mellan Västerfjäll och Jäckvik / The Pite River-Jäckvik. Lists Piteälven-Gásakláhko 19 km, 7-9 hours and Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken 13 km, 4-6 hours. Notes large elevation differences, poor-visibility marking risk, good tent sites in good weather around Gásakláhko and Barturtte, and Tjäurakåtan in poor condition.
officialSources.caveat: The page and downloadable GPX cover the broader BD78 route and are not section-split.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan BD78 GPX
officialSources.evidence: Public GPX for the broader BD78 route. Starts near Piteälven/Västerfjäll at 66.7190103,17.3468528 and continues south toward Jäckvik; 19 km distance split gives an alternate Gásakláhko candidate near 66.5776847,17.2776884.
officialSources.caveat: Generalized broader-route GPX; not section-split, about 703 m from WFS 19 km split.

officialSources.name: Naturvårdsverket state trail WFS BD78
officialSources.evidence: WFS feature OBJECTID 2785651 / GmlID LED.2785651 / Led_ID 30466987 / Statlig_led_ID BD78, Vandringsled BD78 mellan Västerfjäll och Jäkkvik, Barmarksled, geometry quality <=20 m. Starts at the same BD77/BD78 handoff as section 14 end: 66.71854496,17.34937659. Attribute length 30769.75006701 m; computed walking segment about 30.681 km.
officialSources.caveat: Official line is not stage-split; section endpoint is derived by official 19 km stage distance.

officialSources.name: Lantmäteriet Sök ortnamn / Ortnamnsregistret
officialSources.evidence: Official place-name record for Gásakláhko in Arjeplog: id 4014657, type Natur- och terrängnamn, language Lulesamiska, SWEREF99 TM E 600301 N 7388339, converted by research lane to approximately 66.5975793,17.2634070.
officialSources.confidence: high for toponym, low as exact route endpoint
officialSources.caveat: Lantmäteriet place-name coordinates are label/text-placement points, not exact object geometry or a trail-stage boundary.

officialSources.name: OSM / Waymarked Kungsleden Etapp 20: Piteälven-Gásakláhko
officialSources.evidence: OSM relation 18864493 is continuous from OSM Piteälven campsite/stage node 66.7163830,17.3412810 to OSM Gásakláhko campsite/stage node 66.6202757,17.2743685 and is tagged distance=19, but computes only about 14.497 km. OSM relation 18864494 starts at the same campsite node and computes about 16.098 km while tagged distance=13.
officialSources.caveat: Geometry follow-up concluded OSM/Waymarked is semantically mis-split at Gásakláhko; use as facility/continuity evidence, not primary official stage boundary.

officialSources.name: Piteälven Natura 2000 conservation plan
officialSources.evidence: Relevant Natura 2000 water-area context around Piteälven/Tjieggelvas start area.
officialSources.caveat: Point sampling did not support attaching Natura rules to the whole walking line; treat as start-area water sensitivity pending selected-line overlay.

start.coordinateSource: Naturvårdsverket WFS BD77 end / BD78 start; corroborated by Naturkartan BD77/BD78 GPX endpoints nearby

Naturkartan BD78 GPX starts at 66.7190103,17.3468528 about 122 m from the WFS handoff.
For endpoint/access metadata, keep the broader Piteälven endpoint zone rather than treating the handoff as a POI.

end.label: Gásakláhko highland/stage camping area
end.coordinateSource: Provisional WFS BD78 route snap at official STF/Naturkartan 19 km stage distance from Piteälven handoff
caveats: No official Gásakláhko endpoint point feature or waypoint was found.
Gásakláhko is an official Lulesami terrain/place-name and broad highland area, not a discrete official facility.
Lantmäteriet Gásakláhko label is about 66.5975793,17.2634070 and projects to WFS around chainage 17.688 km; this supports the broader area but not an exact endpoint.

OSM/Wikidata/Mapcarta/Wikivoyage Gásakláhko campsite is at 66.6202912,17.2744719, about 4.04 km north of this endpoint and about 14.8 km from the official start; keep it as a facility, not the official section boundary.

endpointGapNotes: WFS/Naturkartan BD77-BD78 handoff and OSM Piteälven campsite convention differ by about 429 m.
WFS line reaches the OSM Gásakláhko campsite point after about 14.786 km from official Piteälven handoff, not the official 19 km.

routeGeometry.geometryImportRecommendation: For later import, use WFS BD78 as the primary base and split at the official 19 km distance for section 15. Carry OSM relation 18864493 as a cross-check and campsite/facility source only. Mark as planning-grade until geometry source policy, selected-line overlay and endpoint convention are formally accepted.

commuteAccess.summary: Both endpoints are remote wilderness stage breaks with no direct bus, train, roadhead, scheduled ferry or normal public pickup. Nearest practical public-transport gateways are Kvikkjokk to the north and Jäckvik to the south, both requiring multiple Kungsleden stages and boat/logistics context.

startClosestCommutePoint.distanceFromEndpoint: about 34 km north by Kungsleden stages from Piteälven, including Sakkat/Mallenjarka boat context; not direct access
startClosestCommutePoint.operatorOrNetwork: Länstrafiken Norrbotten line 94; Båttrafik i Kvikkjokk for lake transfers before preceding stages
startClosestCommutePoint.caveats: Seasonal/limited service. Line 94 and boat timetables must be rechecked for the travel date; endpoint itself has no direct public transport.

endClosestCommutePoint.distanceFromEndpoint: about 36.4 km south by official continuation: Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken 13 km, Riebnes boat 5.4 km, then about 18 km hiking to Jäckvik
endClosestCommutePoint.operatorOrNetwork: Länstrafiken Norrbotten / regional bus service; Riebnes boat and Kapellströmmarna rowboat context on continuation
endClosestCommutePoint.caveats: Not a direct endpoint access point. Continuing south requires Vuonatjviken/Riebnes boat logistics and Kapellströmmarna rowboat handling.

wildCamping.summary: STF lists accommodation as Camping and no STF hut/cabin is present on the stage. Camping is practical near Piteälven/Tjieggelvas, near Tjäurakåtan/small lakes, and in the high Gásakláhko/Barturtte area in good weather.
wildCamping.caveats: Exposed highland camping can be poor or unsafe in wind, fog, sleet or snow. Low forest/lake-shore terrain can be wet and mosquito-heavy.

shelter.summary: Tjäurakåtan is the only shelter candidate found on section 15, and should be treated as poor-condition emergency/wind protection rather than planned lodging.

primitiveCampsites.name: Gásakláhko camp site
primitiveCampsites.recommendation: pending as primitive campsite, not endpoint

fire.summary: No section-specific fire rule found. Fire bans from Länsstyrelsen or municipality override normal outdoor-fire practice. Piteälven firepit is OSM-only and should not be imported without current legality/condition verification.

waste.summary: No official waste service confirmed. A 2019 field-report garbage mention near Tjeggelvas/Piteälven is not enough for import.

protectedAreas.name: Piteälven Natura 2000 SE0820434
protectedAreas.caveats: WMS/point sampling hit Piteälven Natura 2000 near the start water area but not as a continuous walking-line overlap. Final selected-line overlay required.

closuresAndReroutes.caveats: No section-specific closure, reroute, bridge closure, access ban, national park hit, nature-reserve hit or bird/plant protection hit found in checked sources and point sampling. Recheck before public use.

terrainAndWeather: After low/wet shore and forest terrain along Tjieggelvas, the route climbs onto open mountain terrain.
Official text warns markings can be hard to see in rain/fog; high Gásakláhko/Barturtte terrain is exposed to wind, fog, rain, sleet and snow.
Piteälven crossing is bridge-dependent and should not be treated as fordable.
No services, road access or dependable staffed shelter on the stage.

dogsReindeerHuntingFishing.summary: Norrbotten mountain route in reindeer-herding area. Keep dogs leashed or under strict control, especially around reindeer and during 1 March-20 August general wildlife protection. Small-game hunting and fishing rules are date/place-specific and should be checked via NatureIT, Länsstyrelsen and relevant local fishing-card rules before publication.
dogsReindeerHuntingFishing.caveats: Exact sameby, hunting closure and fishing-water overlays were not normalized in this research-only pass.

fireBanCurrentness.summary: Fire risk and bans are date-sensitive. Check Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten, Arjeplog/Jokkmokk municipalities, SMHI/Brandrisk Ute and Krisinformation before runtime publication.

currentnessNotes: Länsstyrelsen county-level 2026-04-22 notice said trail checking had stopped because spring warmth made snow/ice unreliable.
Länsstyrelsen 2026-03-27 county-wide warning about weakened snow/ice was relevant to shoulder-season travel.
SMHI mountain-weather warnings and wind can be section-critical; recheck close to publication.

conditionReports.summary: AllTrails-style section 15 listing gives about 17.1-17.2 km and includes Piteälven camp site, Tjeggelvas Lake and Gásakláhko camp site as top sights, supporting the shorter OSM campsite convention rather than official 19 km split.
conditionReports.caveats: Route-app distance is not official and no endpoint coordinate was exposed by the agent.

conditionReports.summary: Guidebook convention lists a nearby stage as Gistojávrátj to Gásakláhko, 19.7 km, showing that source conventions differ and northern boundary naming is not identical to STF/Naturkartan.
conditionReports.caveats: Snippet/product evidence only; not an official coordinate source.

conditionReports.summary: Community route conventions include Piteälven-Juoksakjåhkå and Juoksakjåhkå-Vuonatjviken splits; Juoksakjåhkå around 66.609926,17.276874 falls around WFS chainage 15.949 km and is not the official 19 km split.
conditionReports.caveats: Community route split, useful for field triangulation only.

conditionReports.summary: Reports Tjäurakåtan/nearby camping and older Piteälven/Tjeggelvas facility context; useful for shelter and water but dated.
conditionReports.caveats: Do not use dated waste/toilet/shelter condition as current without verification.

conditionReports.source: Field reports and blogs (Anders Norén, A Tog's Trek, Goin' Feral, Lukas & Kim, Reddit SOBO 2025, Wikiloc/Komoot)
conditionReports.summary: Consistent field themes: wet/boggy Tjieggelvas/Piteälven start, climb to open fell, exposed plateau weather around Tjäurakåtan/Gásakláhko/Barturtte, intermittent high-ground water, limited shelter, mosquitoes in wet low forest, and no road/public transport on the section.
conditionReports.caveats: Condition reports are not official and may be direction- or season-specific.

sourceContradictions.details: STF/Naturkartan list Piteälven-Gásakláhko as 19 km, but publish no endpoint coordinate. WFS 19 km split is 66.5839492,17.2754676. OSM/Wikidata/Mapcarta campsite is 66.6202912,17.2744719, about 4.04 km north and about 14.8 km from the official start.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use WFS 19 km split as provisional section boundary and keep OSM campsite as facility. Document no official point feature exists.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM relation 18864493 is tagged distance=19 but computes 14.497 km; relation 18864494 is tagged 13 but computes 16.098 km. Both share the OSM campsite boundary.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import OSM section relations as authoritative stage boundaries without correcting the semantic split or accepting different distances.

sourceContradictions.details: Official sources and Lantmäteriet support Gásakláhko as a broad Lulesami terrain/highland place-name; route apps and OSM use a discrete campsite point.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Model the section endpoint as an approximate highland/stage area and suppress terrain labels as facilities.

sourceContradictions.details: WFS BD77/BD78 handoff 66.71854496,17.34937659, Naturkartan BD78 GPX first point 66.7190103,17.3468528 and OSM campsite/stage point 66.7163830,17.3412810 differ by up to about 429 m.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use WFS handoff as official geometry boundary; model OSM Piteälven campsite cluster as facility/access context.

sourceContradictions.details: Official STF/Naturkartan distance is 19 km; AllTrails/route-app/OSM-style routes show about 14.5-17.2 km depending convention; Cicerone uses Gistojávrátj-Gásakláhko 19.7 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Display official 19 km while preserving measured-geometry caveats.

sourceContradictions.details: Map sources may imply shelter/basic hut, while Naturkartan and field reports describe poor condition and unreliable shelter.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not model as lodging; at most import/pending as poor-condition emergency/basic shelter.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM has boat/ferry-like metadata near Piteälven, but official sources and field reports indicate suspension bridge crossing and no required ferry on section 15.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Suppress as ferry; keep only as pending metadata if needed.

sourceContradictions.details: Piteälven Natura 2000 applies around the start water area; point sampling did not find continuous protected-area overlap and WFS BD78 has Skyddat_område null.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not attach full-section protected-area rules without true selected-line overlay.

sourceContradictions.details: Snow/ice, wind, bridge condition, fire bans, hunting closures, dog/reindeer restrictions and water levels can change quickly.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep recheck-before-publication tasks rather than treating current notices as permanent metadata.

agents.result: Confirmed STF/Naturkartan stage identity, official distance/time, BD78 official route context, Piteälven WFS handoff and lack of discrete official Gásakláhko coordinate.
Documented WFS BD78, Naturkartan GPX, OSM relation 18864493, endpoint-distance contradictions and candidate splits.
Identified camping-only official stage, Piteälven and Gásakláhko campsite candidates, Tjäurakåtan, official bridges/fords, toilets/firepit/waste caveats and suppressions.
Confirmed no direct endpoint access; documented Kvikkjokk, Jäckvik, Vuonatjviken and Riebnesluspen access context.
Documented wet start terrain, exposed plateau weather, route-finding, water, camping, mosquitoes, shelter limitations and route-app distance evidence.
Documented no found section-specific closure, Piteälven Natura start-area context, currentness checks and fire/dog/reindeer/hunting/fishing caveats.

researchIterations.coordinatorDecision: Initial batch found a material unresolved endpoint contradiction for Gásakláhko, so a targeted follow-up batch was required before synthesis.

agents.result: Confirmed official sources support Gásakláhko as a highland/toponym and camping area, not a coordinate POI; added Lantmäteriet Ortnamn evidence.
Concluded OSM/Waymarked is semantically mis-split; WFS 19 km split best matches official stage distances and section 16 continuity.
Supported Gásakláhko as broad terrain name near the WFS 19 km split and recommended treating OSM camp as facility rather than endpoint.
Found no guidebook/field evidence for naming the WFS 19 km split as Gásakláhko and favored OSM campsite as semantic endpoint; this dissent is retained as a caveat.

researchIterations.coordinatorDecision: Strong enough for research-ready section file. Use WFS official-distance split as provisional section boundary because it aligns with official 19 km and section 16's 13 km better than OSM, while documenting no official point feature exists and preserving the OSM campsite as a real primitive campsite/facility.

openQuestions: Before runtime import, confirm geometry source/licensing policy for WFS, Naturkartan GPX and OSM/Waymarked linework.
For normalization, decide whether stage boundaries should privilege official distance/WFS splits or OSM relation continuity when they disagree.
Run true selected-line GIS overlay for Natura 2000, nature reserves, bird/plant protection, sameby, fishing/hunting and other restrictions.
Verify Piteälven and Gásakláhko campsite/toilet/firepit candidates current condition before importing as facilities.
Verify Tjäurakåtan current condition before importing as emergency/basic shelter.
Recheck Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan current notices, bridge condition, SMHI mountain weather, fire bans, NatureIT hunting closures and access timetables close to publication.
Section 16 should begin at the same provisional WFS 19 km split unless later normalization chooses a different endpoint convention.

blockingIssuesForRuntimeImport: Geometry source/licensing policy must be confirmed.
Gásakláhko endpoint convention must be accepted: provisional WFS 19 km split versus OSM campsite relation boundary.
Selected-line protected-area/currentness overlays must be run.
Piteälven/Gásakláhko primitive campsite, toilet/firepit and Tjäurakåtan facilities require current verification.
Date-sensitive official currentness, fire-ban, hunting/fishing, weather and access checks must be repeated before publication.
importReadiness.suggestedNextStep: Research section 16 Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken using the section-15 provisional WFS 19 km split as the starting boundary, while testing whether section-16 evidence supports or contradicts that split.
